en:
Eldest son of Ouchi Yoshioki. From birth, his place as heir to the Ouchi clan is assured.
At the Battle of Kanayama Castle, he marches out as commander-in-chief of the attack on the castle, and faces the Mouri Army, which has rushed to relieve Kanayama Castle at the Amago's request. (Ep. 4)
After the Mouri come under the Ouchi's wing, his father Yoshioki dies of illness, and he inherits the headship. (Ep. 6)

Eldest son of Ouchi Yoshioki. From birth, his place as heir to the Ouchi clan is assured.
At the Battle of Kanayama Castle, he marches out as commander-in-chief of the attack on the castle, and faces the Mouri Army, which has rushed to relieve Kanayama Castle at the Amago's request. (Ep. 4)
After the Mouri come under the Ouchi's wing, his father Yoshioki dies of illness, and he inherits the headship.
He sends troops to Yoshida-Koriyama and drives off the Amago Army besieging the castle, saving the Mouri clan from disaster.
(Ep. 6)
He then attacks Gassan-Toda Castle, the Amago stronghold, but the siege stalls, and he finds himself in dire straits instead. (Ep. 7)

Eldest son of Ouchi Yoshioki. From birth, his place as heir to the Ouchi clan is assured.

After the Mouri come under the Ouchi's wing, Yoshioki dies of illness, and he inherits the headship. (Ep. 6)
After the Mouri and Ouchi armies drive off the Amago Army that invaded Yoshida-Koriyama, he seizes on the Amago's weakness and tries to take Gassan-Toda Castle, but the siege stalls, and he finds himself in dire straits instead. (Ep. 7)
After failing to take Gassan-Toda Castle, he turns his back on war and indulges in the tea ceremony and other pastimes, bringing about strife among his retainers. (Ep. 8)

en:
A Sengoku daimyo ruling northern Kyushu. He shows great foresight, protecting Christianity and looking to overseas trade.
At the request of Sue Harukata, who overthrew Ouchi Yoshitaka, he sends his younger brother Yoshinaga to head the Ouchi clan. (Ep. 11)
